constants_used.note: Fixed, disclosed research constants -- NOT tuned per model, NOT the product gpu_policy guard (Section 18 explicitly forbids modifying the product guard in this phase).

implementation: tools/membrane-kv-promotion-prefetch/ownership_state.c: membrane_kv_promo_headroom_ok (llama-free, overflow-checked, unit-tested in test_ownership_state.c) -- wired to real nvidia-smi numbers via headroom_ok_real() in promotion_probe.cpp.

attempts_audited.note: deliberately absurd request (Section 21 fail-closed path); real free VRAM (~3.7 GiB) is nowhere close to the ~1.56 TB required, so this is an unambiguous true-negative, not a close call.

sample_size_caveat: Only 3 real promotion attempts were run through this rule in Phase 12C (2 real successes at comfortable and pressure-regime headroom, 1 forced-huge true-negative). 0/0 false-safe and false-reject is consistent with the rule working correctly on this small sample, but is NOT a statistically powered validation of the constants -- a wider sweep near the actual boundary (headroom of exactly reserve+group+compute+margin +/- a few MiB) was not attempted this phase and would be needed before trusting these exact constant values in a real guard.
